top.badge: OPTIONAL META AI · REAL LOCAL AUDIO
intro.eyebrow: Build for Your World / Theatre and live events
intro.title: From script to approved cue
intro.description: Import a script, approve cues and play local audio with manual GO. Suggestions can be simulated or generated with Meta AI only after you configure the API and explicitly authorize sending an excerpt.
script.heading: Script
script.audioHint: Up to 20 MB · 10 min · mono/stereo. Reload audio after opening JSON.
proposals.heading: Proposals
proposals.help: Create a manual test suggestion or use Meta AI if an API key is configured. Nothing starts playback without human approval.
proposals.label: Cue description
proposals.metaDisclaimer: Only after confirmation, up to 120 script lines (250 characters per line) and 80 audio filenames are sent to Meta. No WAV/MP3 files are sent. API usage may incur charges.
scriptLanguage.label: Script language for AI
scriptLanguage.help: Independent of interface language. Keeps the original script unchanged.
cues.heading: Cue list
cues.help: Only expressly approved suggestions appear here. GO plays the loaded audio; STOP and FADE 1.5 s stop playback. The operator remains in control.
cues.scopeBody: TXT import, human review, local GO/STOP/FADE/STOP ALL and JSON export/import. Reload your audio files after closing or refreshing the page: audio is not embedded in JSON.
footer: Hackathon prototype · Local audio · Meta AI uses an external service only with consent · Save JSON to keep your changes
status.initial: Load the example or import a TXT script to get started.
status.noCues: Approve a proposal to create your first cue.
status.transportStopped: Transport stopped. Initial local audio gain: 50%.
status.proposalApproved: Proposal {id} approved. Cue saved as DRAFT.

status.replaceConfirm: Replace the current show? Save its JSON first if you want to keep it.

status.exampleLoaded: Example loaded. Choose a real WAV or MP3 to test playback.
status.newShow: New show created. No files were deleted from your computer.
status.scriptImported: Imported script {name}. Existing cues were not mixed in.
status.mockAdded: SIMULATED proposal created. Human review is required.
status.projectOpened: Project {name} loaded. Reload local audio files using the original filenames.
status.panic: STOP ALL: local audio was silenced.
status.decoding: Decoding audio locally; nothing is uploaded...
status.audioLoaded: REAL audio “{name}” loaded ({duration} s, {channels} channel(s)). You can create a cue.
status.metaConfigured: Meta Model API configured ({model}). Each analysis requires confirmation.
status.metaUnavailable: Meta AI is not configured. Set MODEL_API_KEY in the terminal running the server.
status.metaOffline: The local Meta AI service is unavailable.
status.metaInProgress: Contacting Meta Model API… No audio will start automatically.
status.metaImported: Meta AI returned {count} suggestions. Review them before approval; no cue executed GO.
status.confirmMeta:
Authorize an external Meta AI request?

Up to 120 script lines (250 characters per line) and 80 audio filenames/IDs will be sent to Meta. No WAV/MP3 audio is sent. This may use billable API credits.

No cue will run automatically.
